plateNote: Read on the promoted plate (art/backgrounds/room-50-ledge.png, room-50 operation 2, derived and promoted by tools/art/interiors-plate.mjs; frame.json beside the candidate). Every rect below was read off that picture.
walkableNote: THE LEDGE, from the mine's mouth out to the cliff's edge: it narrows to the right, where the path goes down.

scaling.note: ROOM 50'S DEPTH, FROM THE MASTER: Thad was painted about 309 tall with his feet at y 530 (cropped from row 290); along Room 5's exterior slope (0.68 a row) that is 221 at y 400 and 532 at the ledge's near edge.

entrances.note: Out of the mine's far end.
The first crossing, out of the line's right passage.
Through the mine from the washout, the way known (doc 107).
Up the path from the tents, at its top.

hotspotsNote: Generous over the thing the player sees, smallest first. THE CAMP BELOW is the camp far down by the river; THE RAVINE, its walls. THE PATH DOWN, the roped zigzag at the right, is the way down to the tents (Room 51).

THE MINE.note: Doc 109: the way back, through the mine to the washout, the way known (doc 107).

THE PATH DOWN.note: Doc 109: the path down the ravine wall to the camp, in view of it all the way (Room 51, the tents).

defaultVerbsNote: Errata 28b. Every object is looked at on a bare click; every way walks.

occlusion.note: Nothing stands nearer the camera than the walk band.

figureLight.note: Errata 265 (Tyler, 2026-11-10, on the Gulch: "I defer to you"). In the Gulch's daylight Thad was the one cool, dark thing on a warm tan ground, apart from the Gulch's own men, who are painted in it. A warm light and nothing else: his coat stays blue and takes the sun.
